# Hosts the panel (internal/hostname) and the installer (valid_domain in
# installer/src/net.rs) judge alike. One per line: the verdict, a space, the host.
#   name  a DNS name: Name and Valid accept it, and so does the installer
#   ip    an IP address: Valid accepts it, Name and the installer do not
#   bad   neither
name vpn.example.com
name a-b.example.co.uk
name xn--80ak6aa92e.com
name VPN.Example.COM
name a.io
name 1st.example.net
name 123.example.com
name aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.example.com
ip 1.2.3.4
ip 203.0.113.10
ip 2001:db8::1
ip ::1
bad example
bad localhost
bad vpn.example.123
bad 1.2.3
bad -a.example.com
bad a-.example.com
bad a..example.com
bad .example.com
bad example.com.
bad a_b.example.com
bad vpn example.com
bad vpn.example.com:443
bad https://vpn.example.com
bad пример.рф
bad aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.example.com
bad 1.2.3.4/32
